children: China’s annual inflation accelerated to 0.8% in August 2026 from July’s six-month low of 0.5%, in line with market expectations.
Non-food prices rose at a steeper rate (1.2% vs 0.9% in July), led by a sharp increase in transport costs (2.5% vs 0.4%) amid higher fuel prices and stronger travel-related demand.
Upward price pressure also came from clothing (1.3% vs 1.4%), healthcare (2.7% vs 2.9%), and education (1.4% vs 1.3%).
In contrast, housing costs remained subdued (-0.3% vs -0.3%).
Monthly, consumer prices increased 0.4%, topping forecasts of a 0.3% gain and reversing a 0.1% drop in July.
It also marked the highest monthly reading since February.

title: China Inflation Rate Accelerates as Expected
